title: Drain Vaporize Windows test-baseline failures
description: Vaporize now resolves and compiles from private/product-lines/vaporize in consistent local-dependency mode, but the Windows test run exits with failures across fixture assumptions, command authority, generated documentation, i18n expectations, and missing host tooling.

historicalContent.expectedBehavior: The complete Vaporize suite passes on Windows from its standalone swift-universal product repository and produces a durable summary receipt.
currentEvidence: SPM_USE_LOCAL_DEPS=1 and VAPORIZE_DISABLE_SWIFTLY=1 swift test completed the 3,303-step build in 144.24 seconds.
Generated-manual assertions observe CRLF content and an empty parsed option set.
Maintainer SwiftPM authority tests report Windows authority and Package.resolved snapshot failures.
i18n source-gate tests disagree with the current lowercase Bead identity and error rendering.
AppleProjectSpecCore xcrun materialization cannot run because the pkl command is absent from PATH.
Swift emitted repeated nonfatal incremental dependency-graph warnings at long .build paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Classify every failing target as a product defect, Windows expectation defect, or missing host prerequisite.
Make generated-manual and snapshot assertions portable across Windows line endings and filesystem semantics.
Exercise Windows core commands through an explicit swift-win or wcode authority.
Provision or explicitly gate the pkl-dependent materialization test with actionable diagnostics.
Run the complete suite successfully on Windows and save a concise target-level summary receipt.
Track long-path incremental-cache warnings separately if they persist after the functional failures are drained.
historicalContent.scopeBoundary: Do not weaken product assertions merely to make Windows green; preserve platform intent and split independently owned failures into child beads before implementation.
